planner: DPRK (KPA Strategic Force, KCNA statements of 9 and 10 Aug 2017)
source_doc: Korea Times (Yonhap), 'N. Korea threatens missile strike at Guam', 9 Aug 2017 (KCNA, KPA Strategic Force statement)
quote: It cited the need to contain the U.S. major military bases on Guam, including the Anderson Air Force Base, where U.S. strategic bombers are based.
notes: 'Enveloping fire' plan with four Hwasong-12; the 10 Aug statement sets impact points in the sea 30-40 km from Guam (Japan Times), so the aim points are not the base itself. KCNA spelling 'Anderson'.
